ambiguities_or_notes: Translated chapter by chapter directly from the audited Russian (SHA-256 verified); the English companion was used afterward only as an alignment check (D0002).

Mechanical alignment: 44/44 page markers in identical sequence; title and ten chapter headings; paragraph counts identical to the source in every chapter. A per-paragraph length-ratio scan flagged only short dialogue lines, each rechecked.

Numbers checked as in the English coverage record (700 + 2,300 = 3,000 rubles; 10,000/7,000; 80/40 rubles; 3 + 5 vs 20 rubles; 15/7/25 rubles; 8 and 5 versts; 22 souls; 56 desyatinas, 30 sazhens, 200 + 25, over 12 thousand, 8 thousand, 100–150; the 9th; 15 years; 12:10; 20 and 50 paces; 30 sazhens and half a verst; two months, three toes, twenty years).
хозяин = stăpân throughout (Stăpânul cel mare for God in ch. VII); the cook's хозяин in ch. I is her husband ('omul tău'); the Grishkino head of household is 'bătrânul gospodar'.
работник = argat in the body; the title follows the established Romanian 'Stăpân și slugă' (D0003).
вино in peasant speech = votcă (Marfa's eighth-pail; the drinking in the first days of the holiday); the wine Vasily Andreich drank with his guests stays 'vin', as in the source wording.
бескостречный = 'cel fără crupă' (cf. English 'the rumpless one'); the exact defect is uncertain.
Pushkin's 'Зимний вечер' as garbled by Petrukha is translated from Tolstoy's dialect wording; Pulson/Paulson/Pulpson preserved.
Present-tense passages in ch. VIII, IX, and X preserved; italic *Acum știu.* preserved.
Typography: comma-below ș/ț throughout (a scan confirmed no cedilla forms remain); Romanian „…” for thoughts; em-dash dialogue.
Same seven non-substantive transcription artifacts as the English unit; record copied to project/qa/source_suspected/.
Process note: translated and audited by the same model in one working context; not an independent or human verification.
